7:56 A really important point on why inflation is necessary for an economy to thrive is that it encourages spending over saving. Your money is losing value, so it makes more sense to spend it, especially on things that might generate value that outpaces inflation. In the natural state of deflation, with finite money supply, less innovation would happen because people would be more incentivized to hoard and save, less investment and less spending. Deflation led to the Great Depression. Not to say inflation is good, but some amount of it is necessary in moderation for an economy to thrive.
